decisions.reason: Despite two years without a clear website presence, the certified multi-model HVAC line is close to the core heat-exchanger business and carries enough sunk engineering and certification investment that management would still be inclined to continue it.
The marine box cooler system had visible claimed market traction, fits the established marine cooling portfolio, and is the kind of proven adjacent line management would be reluctant to withdraw.

With no later market signal beyond its initial dedicated page and no observation for two years, management can more easily let this single marine cooling unit go than keep justifying further commitment.
The compact oil cooler line still sits near the firm’s established offer and the multi-model launch implies enough prior commitment that management would somewhat more likely persist than exit.

Although it supported the air-cooler offering, the finned-tube product’s disappearance from view for two years weakens public commitment and makes redeployment of resources more likely than continued backing.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes align well with the firm’s R&D-heavy engineering path, and management can plausibly treat the weaker visibility as integration into the broader portfolio rather than a reason to abandon it.
